statement: For a based ambient-null plane homeomorphism loop, the orbitwise C.27/C.29 median formulas assemble to a jointly continuous family of homeomorphisms of the entire closed union of nonopen loop-group orbits, with jointly continuous inverse and exact equivariance. Consequently every hyperbolic centralizer loop whose canonical lifted loop-group has no open orbit is null-homotopic in the original centralizer.
depends_on: C.27 exact median formula and conjugacy naturality; C.28 compact word-track orbit classification and intrinsic continuity; C.29 plane winding comparison and based circle lifts; C.31 track control, inverse identity and fixed-stratum continuity; Schoenflies arc and collar coordinates; ordinary covering lifting and uniqueness
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b) infinite-operator request; nonopen-stratum assembly in C.12
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The proof supplies the missing nonfixed-stratum continuity rather than assuming that the orbit partition is a foliation. No global action on a circle collar or its universal covering is asserted.
notes: The decisive local cap argument uses a short original-loop segment composed with its initial inverse, or its inverse path, to move a nonfixed limit point in either intrinsic direction. A folded nearby arc has two explicit first-exit endpoints outside a small rectangle, so an intrinsically continuous orbit path staying in the rectangle cannot escape that cap. This proves the sequential no-excess property for subarcs and continuity of medians, including coincident limiting endpoints. Circle limits use the actual map [0,1] times V to a collar annulus, its based lift, and local lifts of the original short paths inside one covering chart. The endpoint deck integer vanishes by the exact C.29 winding comparison. Prefix endpoint convergence then proves joint continuity for varying contraction parameters. The inverse is the C.31 inverse-loop formula. C35 proves that this particular median family need not extend equivariantly. C36 and C37 give compatible contractions on X2, including all dimension-two accumulation. Matching this boundary family to the exterior of X2 and treating dimension-zero/one proper operator frontiers remain unresolved.
